stem.en: The monsoon usually reaches Jodhpur around 5 July and leaves around 17 September. It reaches Kolkata in mid-June and leaves in mid-October. What does this show?

text.en: The place reached last loses the monsoon first, so its stay is shorter

feedback.en: Yes. Jodhpur is reached later than Kolkata and left a month earlier.

text.en: The place reached last keeps the monsoon the longest

feedback.en: No. Jodhpur is reached later and still loses the monsoon sooner.

text.en: The monsoon leaves every place on the same day

feedback.en: No. Jodhpur loses it about a month before Kolkata.

text.en: The monsoon leaves the east first and the west last

feedback.en: No. Jodhpur in the west loses it first.

explanation.en: Jodhpur has the monsoon for about 11 weeks, from 5 July to 17 September. Kolkata has it for about 17 weeks, from mid-June to mid-October. The far north-west is last in and first out.

hints.en: Now compare the dates when the monsoon leaves.
